## Checklist

- [ ] `scripts/validate.sh` passes locally
- [ ] Folder name, `plugin.json` name and marketplace entry match
- [ ] `version` bumped in `plugin.json` (for changes to an existing mod)
- [ ] Mod `README.md` added or updated
- [ ] Root `README.md` **Mods** table updated (for a new mod)
- [ ] No network, telemetry or file access beyond what the mod's README states
